news.title: Japan records a trade deficit for 4th month as oil imports soar
news.summary: Japan’s trade deficit totaled 1.1 trillion yen ($7 billion) last month as surging oil prices due to the conflicts in the Middle East sent the cost of imports soaring.  It was the fourth straight month of red ink, according to the Finance Ministry’s preliminary data Wednesday.  Japan’s imports in August rose 28% from the same month a year ago to 11.15 trillion yen ($71.9 billion), as the price of oil soared.
